title: Option to transform minimized windows into thumbnails of in place of icons when using the "Do not group" setting
line: The task manager can now show minimized windows as small previews of the window instead of the app icon.
explanation: Task buttons always draw the application icon, so with "Do not group" several minimized windows of the same app (or a minimized-only dock, as the reporter uses) look identical until each one is hovered. The tooltip already shows a window thumbnail through PipeWire screencasting, but the button itself never did. The change adds an Appearance option, off by default, that loads the same PipeWire thumbnail into the icon area of any button standing for a single minimized window, and shrinks the app icon to its bottom-right corner so the app stays recognisable.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: optionally show minimized windows as thumbnails

Minimized windows always looked like their application icon, so a row of
them could not be told apart without hovering each one. Add an option that
shows a thumbnail of the window instead, with a small icon in its corner.

BUG: 438008

patches.diff:
From e27999bf56606e7132807c5b7efca273159a11f6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 02:17:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: optionally show minimized windows as
 thumbnails

Minimized windows always looked like their application icon, so a row of
them could not be told apart without hovering each one. Add an option that
shows a thumbnail of the window instead, with a small icon in its corner.

BUG: 438008
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml                 |  4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml |  6 ++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml             | 22 +++++++++++++++++++-
 3 files changed, 31 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..bc9387e27f 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -75,6 +75,10 @@
       <label>Whether to show tooltips when hovering task buttons.</label>
       <default>true</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="minimizedThumbnails" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether task buttons of single minimized windows show a thumbnail of the window instead of the application icon.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="taskMaxWidth" type="Enum">
       <label>Tune the max width of task items.</label>
       <choices>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 6f19a68e96..93ce44c16c 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
     property bool cfg_indicateAudioStreams
     property bool cfg_interactiveMute
     property bool cfg_tooltipControls
+    property alias cfg_minimizedThumbnails: minimizedThumbnails.checked
     property alias cfg_fill: fill.checked
     property alias cfg_maxStripes: maxStripes.value
     property alias cfg_forceStripes: forceStripes.checked
@@ -81,6 +82,11 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
             enabled: root.plasmaPaAvailable
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: minimizedThumbnails
+            text: i18nc("@option:check section General", "Show minimized windows as previews instead of icons")
+        }
+
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: fill
             text: i18nc("@option:check section General", "Fill free space on panel")
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..16bf56998a 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -569,10 +569,30 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
             return margin;
         }
 
+        Loader {
+            id: thumbnailSourceItem
+
+            // Read by PipeWireThumbnail.qml
+            readonly property var winId: task.model.WinIdList?.[0]
+            readonly property bool hasThumbnail: (item as PipeWireThumbnail)?.hasThumbnail ?? false
+
+            anchors.fill: parent
+
+            active: Plasmoid.configuration.minimizedThumbnails
+                && task.model.IsMinimized
+                && !task.model.IsGroupParent
+                && !task.model.IsExcludedFromCapture
+            asynchronous: true
+            source: "PipeWireThumbnail.qml"
+        }
+
         Kirigami.Icon {
             id: icon
 
-            anchors.fill: parent
+            anchors.right: parent.right
+            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+            width: thumbnailSourceItem.hasThumbnail ? Math.round(Math.min(parent.width, parent.height) / 2) : parent.width
+            height: thumbnailSourceItem.hasThumbnail ? width : parent.height
 
             active: task.highlighted
             enabled: true
--

media.caption: Do not group: the minimized "usr" Dolphin window and the minimized Konsole show only their app icons.
Same windows with the option on: each minimized window shows its own preview with a small app icon in the corner.
New checkbox "Show minimized windows as previews instead of icons" (off by default).
